scheme_name: Award of Scholarship to the Cadets Belonging to UT of Puducherry and Studying in Rashtriya Indian Military College, Dehradun
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must belong to the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by domicile (continuous residence of at least 5 years).
Applicant must be studying at Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹20,000 per annum, disbursed directly to the Aadhaar‑seeded bank account via DBT.
